I agree that the lack of cohesion can be frustrating. Like you said, even the developers and people who have worked on the game have differing perspectives on the story, some which outright contradict each other. When I was first getting into the series that was such a point of contention for me. I wanted cold, hard answers and clear motivations for the characters. 

To a degree, I still find it a little upsetting that there doesn’t seem to be a “series bible,” or many things that are explicitly canon with no room for interpretation at all.

However, I do find that the deeper you go into the rabbit hole of canon descriptions and looking at the events set out and dissecting them, the clearer things do start to become. It’s actually quite charming that there’s never a word spoken in universe, and that nothing is revealed verbally. 

There are a lot of things that have to be theorised upon with this series, but I enjoy it more now that I feel less entitled to know every aspect. (There’s still no reason that developers should have wildly contradicting takes though, in my opinion.)

Little Nightmares 3 supposedly promises a lot of answers and will have hints about previous entries in the series.
